name: Keepsake
description: Privacy-first universal wishlist: save products from any site into collections that sort themselves. Stays in your browser.

_execute_action.description: Open Keepsake for the current page

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: http: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
